textbookBox.concept: Reasons for depletion include expansion of agriculture, large development projects, mining, grazing, fuelwood collection and, as the book stresses, unequal access to resources.

beats.en: Reasons for depletion include expansion of agriculture, large development projects, mining, grazing, fuelwood collection and, as the book stresses, unequal access to resources.

beats.en: The Indian Wildlife Protection Act of 1972 created protected areas and banned hunting. Project Tiger, launched in 1973, set up tiger reserves such as Corbett and Sunderbans.
